patch_list: Presses the Daily Streak Check-in button for you when the app is open, once a day. It runs the app's own check-in, so it needs you to be signed in. Add "Auto check-in in the background" so you don't have to open the app each day.

Does the daily streak check-in without you opening ROX. Shortly after midnight (Pakistan time) an alarm that also fires while the phone sleeps wakes ROX; if today's check-in isn't done yet, ROX opens its own screen for a moment, presses Ch…
Stops ROX from sending a patched copy to the "Get this app from Play" screen and closing, so no separate installer-source patch is needed.

Closes ROX once it has been out of sight for three minutes and nothing is playing, so its timers, ad and analytics code stop using the battery. This also covers ROX being started in the background by a push message or a job. Notifications…
Stops banner and full-screen ads from loading. Rewarded video ads are left alone, so the watch-an-ad-for-points option keeps working.

Stops the "Update Available" screen that blocks ROX until you install a newer version, so this patched copy keeps working after ROX releases an update. ROX's own code is told the app is a newer version than it is; Android still sees the re…

Keeps ROX's background service from running. It can hold the phone awake, restarts itself when the system stops it and starts again after a reboot, which drains the battery. The check-in and the rest of the app don't need it.
